name: Kindia
purpose: City-specific cadastral and public parcel geometry investigation; registry evidence, retrieved geometry and runtime qualification are assessed separately.

queries.query: Kindia Guinea cadastral parcel map official cadastre GIS
queries.result: Search found the official cadastre.mines.gov.gn ArcGIS application layer, but the viewer reports sign-in and the anonymous REST metadata returns Token Required. No public Kindia parcel layer was identified.

queries.query: Guinée Kindia cadastre parcelles carte géoportail site officiel
queries.result: Search found the official Kindia prefecture portal and Guinea government/land-administration references, plus the same official cadastre.mines.gov.gn ArcGIS service. No anonymous public parcel schema or Kindia parcel download was found.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.name: guinea-cadastre-application-layer
requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: JSON error code 499 Token Required; no login or token was attempted.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.name: guinea-arcgis-service-catalog
requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Anonymous catalog exposed SSRSMaps_SOE MapServer and Landfolio GP services; no parcel feature service was listed.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.name: guinea-ssrs-mapserver-schema
requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Only layer 0 Pays was exposed; polygon country-boundary layer in WKID 104257/latestWkid 8999, not parcel data.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.name: guinea-ssrs-layer-fields
requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Safe fields were OBJECTID and ISO_CTRY; no cadastral parcel identifier field was present.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.name: bounded-anonymous-country-layer-query
requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: One MultiPolygon country-boundary feature returned with OBJECTID 1 and ISO_CTRY GN. Not retained because it is not a parcel and would not evidence city parcel coverage.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.name: guinea-cadastre-viewer
requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Public REST landing page reachable; MapPortal application itself sign-in/token gated.

officialSources.scope: National ArcGIS service catalog; anonymous catalog does not expose a public parcel layer.
Local prefecture information portal; no parcel map/API was exposed in discovery.

registryBasis: No local Kindia registry/cadastre map, parcel API, or public parcel geometry was evidenced. The official national GIS host was identified, but its application layer requires a token and its anonymous public layer is country boundaries only.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Unknown; no public parcel layer or documentation establishing Kindia coverage was available.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Only a national country-boundary layer was anonymously queried; this is not parcel evidence.

safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel identifier if publicly returned
uncertainty: Token-gated application layer was not accessed with credentials.

doNotInfer: Zero exact-point parcel hits, map extent misses, token walls, or unusable viewers are not evidence of citywide absence.
